newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) left its key discount rate for June unchanged at 2.5 percent per month, a central bank official told Reuters on Tuesday.
It is the fourth consecutive month that the discount rate has remained unchanged at an annual 35.04 percent.
The discount rate, used by the central bank as an instrument for regulating the amount of cash in circulation, was last cut in March after being kept at a monthly 4.5 percent since June 1996.

NBY sets its discount rate each month using a basket that includes interest rates on the open money market and its short-term bonds, price rises, expected monetary developments, credit demand and money supply. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
